note: DET-1 (ADR-0104 D6). Every v2 live-QA miss plus negative cases, owner-curated (ADR-0098 D7), never auto-added. Two case kinds, both mustPass and scored end-to-end by apps/quoky/src/personal-v2-acceptance.test.ts against the same baseline entry. `guard`: `text` is a recorded/representative GENERAL_CHAT model reply to `userText`; the provider-neutral internal-action claim guard (core chat-policy) must replace it (`guarded: true` with the claimed `domain`) or leave it (`guarded: false`); replayed with zero provider calls. `turn`: `text` is sent through the production runtime (ctx as in turn-handler-routing.v1.json); `route`/`kind`/`reply`/`providerCalls` as there, plus the reply labels `internal-action-not-done:<domain>`, `commit-already-committed`, `pr-already-created`, `branch-already-cleaned`, `remote-branch-already-cleaned`, and `own-memory-not-found` (v3 W3-L01: a `classifier` route pinned to `providerCalls: 0`). Changing the lexicon (INTERNAL_ACTION_LEXICON_VERSION) needs a corpus update.
